verdict.rationale: Copilot's agent mode can edit files and 'validate files with agent mode,' cloud/local sandboxes let it safely execute code and interact with the filesystem, and Autofix provides contextual explanations and suggested fixes for vulnerabilities—together supporting root-cause investigation and fix verification. However, there is no explicit documentation of a structured reproduce-diagnose-verify workflow (e.g., running/generating tests, confirming a bug fix via test execution) and no independent/hands-on evidence validating this specific debugging loop. Missing for 10: dedicated reproduction/test-generation workflow, explicit fix-verification evidence, and independent corroboration of debugging effectiveness.
